segments.sn35.125:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati hatthigāme.
segments.sn35.125:1.2: Atha kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.125:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
segments.sn35.125:1.4: Ko pana, bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti?(Yathā purimasuttantaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
segments.sn35.125:1.6: Ayaṃ kho, gahapati, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.

lines: 124-126. Gahapativaggassa paṭhame uggoti paṇītadāyakānaṃ aggauggo, so bhagavatā “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ paṇītadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ uggo gahapatī”ti evaṃ etadagge ṭhapito.
Sesametesu ceva dvīsu, tatiye ca vuttatthameva.
124-126. Dvīsūti imasmiṃ gahapativagge paṭhamadutiyesu tatiye ca vuttatthameva pāṭhajātaṃ apubbaṃ natthīti attho.
